title: DAY 1 — LESSON 5: EGO OR TEAM-FIRST MINDSET?

questions.prompt: A colleague suggests a better way to organise treatment supplies. How should you respond?
options: Reject the idea because you have more experience.
Consider the suggestion and evaluate whether it improves operations.
Ignore the suggestion because it did not come from management.

questions.prompt: Another therapist receives excellent client feedback. How should you respond?
options: Congratulate her and learn from what she does well.
Complain that management does not appreciate you.
Tell colleagues that the praise is undeserved.

questions.prompt: You make a mistake that causes a delay. How should you respond?
options: Keep quiet so nobody discovers it.
Acknowledge the mistake and help correct the problem.

questions.prompt: A less-experienced employee asks you for guidance. How should you respond?
options: Tell her she should already know.
Offer appropriate guidance when you can.
Refuse because helping might make her better than you.

questions.prompt: You disagree with a supervisor's instruction. How should you respond?
options: Respectfully ask questions and explain any relevant concerns.
Refuse to discuss the matter because you feel insulted.
Complain to colleagues without seeking clarification.
